name: Pagination
usage: Pagination of lists that are not tables, such as card lists and search results

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new page and page size when the page or the page size changes.

props.name: showSizeChanger
props.description: Shows the page size selector. By default it is shown when `total` is more than 50.

props.name: showTotal
props.description: Text before the page numbers, built from the total number of items, such as "128 items".

props.name: size
props.description: Size: `sm` under tables and in panels. Without it, the size follows the density.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Lists outside a table are paginated on their own; for a DataTable, put the Pagination in its `footer`.
